title: Residual Expert Routing for Text-Only Domain Adaptation of Factorized Transducer ASR
abstract: arXiv:2610.32637v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fine-tuning the non-blank predictor of a factorized transducer on target-domain text improves recognition on that domain but degrades performance on the source domain. A single interpolation weight between base and adapted predictors cannot resolve this: the adapted predictor helps at some prefixes and hurts at others, often within one utterance. We propose conservative residual routing: the adapted predictor becomes a residual correction to the base, and a 16k-parameter gate decides at each prefix how much of it to admit. Closing the gate reproduces the base exactly. On a 40-hour conversational corpus, routing retains essentially all of the text-only gain on two held-out domains (19.89 to 16.74, 20.91 to 16.21 WER) while leaving source-domain WER unchanged (12.90 to 12.93); the adapted predictor alone costs 1.08 WER. translated_title: 面向因子化换能器语音识别纯文本领域自适应的残差专家路由
translated_abstract: 在目标领域文本上微调因子化换能器的非空白预测器，可以提升该领域的识别效果，但会损害源领域的性能。基础预测器与自适应预测器之间的单一插值权重无法解决这一问题：自适应预测器在某些前缀上有帮助，而在另一些前缀上有害，这种情况常常发生在同一句话内。我们提出保守残差路由方法：将自适应预测器作为对基础预测器的残差修正，并由一个1.6万参数的门控在每个前缀处决定接纳多少残差修正。关闭门控即可完全复现基础模型。在一个40小时的会话语料库上，路由方法在两个留出领域上基本保留了纯文本自适应的全部收益（词错误率分别从19.89降至16.74、从20.91降至16.21），同时源领域词错误率保持不变（12.90到12.93）；而单独使用自适应预测器会造成1.08的词错误率损失。路由方法无需在目标领域音频上进行针对各领域的调优。分析表明，门控的行为并非简单的领域级检测器……
tldr: 提出保守残差路由方法，利用轻量门控在每个前缀处动态决定是否接纳文本自适应预测器的残差修正，从而在保留目标领域纯文本自适应收益的同时，使源领域性能完全不受损害。
en_tdlr: Conservative residual routing with a lightweight gate dynamically admits residual corrections from a text-adapted predictor at each prefix, retaining essentially all text-only adaptation gains on target domains while leaving source-domain performance unchanged.
